```artifact
Feature: System Access and User Management

  As a user, I want to access the system only on specified pin codes
  So that I can ensure the system is available in designated zones

Scenario Outline: Accessing the system on specified pin codes
  Given the system is configured with pin codes in the Parameter Control File
  When I attempt to access the system using a valid pin code
  Then I should be granted access
  And when I attempt to access the system using an invalid pin code
  Then I should be denied access

Examples:
  | Pin Code | Access Granted | Access Denied |
  | 1234     | Yes            | No            |
  | 5678     | Yes            | No            |
  | 9012     | No            | Yes           |

Feature: User Authentication

  As a user, I want to authenticate using a login/user-id and password
  So that I can securely access the system

Scenario Outline: Authenticating with login/user-id and password
  Given the system requires user authentication
  When I provide a valid login/user-id and password
  Then I should be authenticated
  And when I provide an invalid login/user-id or password
  Then I should not be authenticated

Examples:
  | Login/User-ID | Password | Authenticated | Not Authenticated |
  | user123       | pass123  | Yes          | No               |
  | user456       | pass456  | No          | Yes              |
  | user789       | pass789  | Yes          | No               |

Feature: Speciality and Doctor Linkage

  As a doctor, I want to be linked to a speciality
  So that I can provide consultations to patients

Scenario Outline: Linking a doctor to a speciality
  Given the system requires a doctor to be linked to a speciality
  When I link a doctor to a speciality
  Then I should be linked to that speciality
  And when I link a doctor to a non-existent speciality
  Then I should not be linked

Examples:
  | Doctor ID | Speciality | Linked | Not Linked |
  | doc123     | Cardiology | Yes    | No         |
  | doc456     | Neurology  | Yes    | No         |
  | doc789     | None      | No     | Yes        |

Feature: Patient Registration and Consultation Requests

  As a patient, I want to register and request consultations
  So that I can receive medical services

Scenario Outline: Registering and requesting consultations
  Given the system requires a patient to register and request consultations
  When I register as a patient
  Then I should be registered
  And when I request a consultation
  Then I should be linked to a speciality
  And when I request multiple consultations
  Then I should be linked to multiple specialities

Examples:
  | Patient ID | Speciality | Consultation Requests | Registered |
  | patient123  | Cardiology | 1                     | Yes       |
  | patient456  | Neurology  | 2                     | Yes       |
  | patient789  | None      | 0                     | Yes       |

```
